title: Unicorn World South Sports Park v3
status: Art-side seam and ball-fit repairs with static pixel QA; gameplay not implemented

region_seams.status: Registered generated overlay with declared narrow alpha blend; inspect static repaired preview. Apply overlay over unchanged source regions.

world.travel: One continuous scrolling world is intended; no teleport or separate level mechanic is proposed.

camera.notes: 3x4 portrait view areas or 2x6 landscape view areas across the proposed full world; calibrate against actual hub actor scale, not the overview.

geometry.coordinate_system: Region-local pixels unless explicitly world. All shapes are proposed art-registration starting points, NOT verified runtime collision geometry.

navigation.notes: Keep central flower islands and planted borders collidable; route around them. Validate all entrances at actor footprint scale.

basketball.notes: Stationary assisted-shot mode; painted markings are decoration.

tennis.notes: Use normalized court coordinates projected into quadrilateral. Racket collision center must derive from pose anchor; never use body rectangle.

volleyball.notes: Play travels left-right. A north-south/receding net is required; horizontal net is only an alternate.
volleyball.net_fit_note: Receding net foot centers deviate about22 pixels on either side of ideal x768; see receding-net manifest for uniform scale and translation. No exact baseline fit is claimed.

bounded_games.skate: bank plus roller, no jump timing requirement, bypass permitted
bounded_games.basketball: ready/aim/release, goal3 baskets, miss resets ball only
bounded_games.tennis: ready/backswing/contact, fitted racket, goal5 returns, miss re-serves
bounded_games.volleyball: ready/bump/set/hit, assisted ball positioning, goal3 returns, miss re-serves

draw_contract: Draw original terrain regions then registered masked seam overlays
Sports action manifest is authoritative for equipment layers, dimensions, pivots and ball contact
Basketball uses exactly one separate ball in all three states, behind ready/aim gripping hooves and in front on release
Tennis racket is already fitted into action art; never draw a second racket
Volleyball set contains a fitted ball; hide external ball during set and restore its matching-size ball at recorded exit anchor
Follow hoop foreground layer registration and court-plane net sorting contract
Hoop foreground: same original RGB multiplied by registered coverage mask, redrawn only inside current ball bounds; see exact contract.
